podcast.body: In the early 1980s, George Clinton, under his own name, achieved a number 1 hit with this digital funk hip hop jam, which featured loopy catchphrases like "Bow Wow Wow, Yippee-Yo, Yippee-A" that became part of hip hop lingo. "And in the early 80s, under his own name, George Clinton would hit the top with his digital funk hip hop jam Atomic Dog."
